title: Overhead Flashing Yellow 'X' Lane-Control Signal: Use This Center Reversible Lane ONLY for Turning Left (With Caution)!

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All visible vehicles face away from camera in same direction; no opposing head-on pair in one lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: No car interior or steering wheel is visible; subject absent.

single_bulb_signal.note: Background vertical traffic signal on right shows two lit lenses at once - top amber/red and bottom green both illuminated.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Double-yellow on left of travel lanes, curb/sidewalk on right, all traffic forward on right side.

zero_text.note: All signs, signal backs, and license plates are blank geometric shapes; no letters or numbers visible.

scene_match.note: Gantry shows red X left, flashing yellow X center, green arrow right with blue sedan pausing in center lane with left blinker to turn left.

result.summary: Lane-use teaching is correct but background traffic signal shows two lit lenses simultaneously, failing single-bulb rule.

teaching_correct.note: Blue sedan correctly uses center flashing-yellow-X lane only to pause with signal on for left turn.

result.what_i_see: A blue sedan with left blinker on pauses straddling a lane line under a steel gantry with red X, yellow X, and green arrow, while other cars drive ahead on a daylight urban arterial.
